micUnsupported: This browser can't use the microphone here. Try a recent Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge.
micInApp: The browser built into this app can't use the microphone. Open this page in Chrome or Safari instead.
micBlocked: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site. Allow it in the site settings, usually behind the icon next to the address, then reload the page.
micDismissed: The page needs your permission to use the microphone. Try again and choose Allow when your browser asks.
micNotFound: No microphone was found. Plug one in or switch it on, then try again.
micBusy: Something else is using the microphone, like a call or another app. Close it and try again.
micInterrupted: The microphone cut out, maybe because of a call or a headset coming unplugged. Try again when you're ready.
micHidden: Listening stops when you switch away from the page. Start again whenever you're ready.
micFailed: Something went wrong while starting the microphone. Reload the page and try again.
micBluetooth: That looks like a Bluetooth headset. Its microphone drops to phone-call quality, so the phone's own microphone will read you better.
micSilent: No sound is coming in from the microphone. Check that it isn't muted, then sing or hum.
levelQuiet: Too quiet. Sing a little louder, or move closer to the microphone.
levelLoud: That's loud enough to distort. Move back a little from the microphone.
